views.name: over_level_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  coalesce(b.match_id, e.match_id) AS match_id,
  coalesce(b.innings_no, e.innings_no) AS innings_no,
  coalesce(b.over_id, e.over_id) AS over_id,
  coalesce(sum(b.runs_scored), 0) AS runs_scored_sum,
  coalesce(sum(e.extra_runs), 0) AS extra_runs_sum,
  coalesce(sum(b.runs_scored), 0) + coalesce(sum(e.extra_runs), 0) AS runs_conceded_in_over,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ball_by_ball bb
    WHERE bb.match_id = coalesce(b.match_id, e.match_id)
      AND bb.innings_no = coalesce(b.innings_no, e.innings_no)
      AND bb.over_id = coalesce(b.over_id, e.over_id)
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_ball_records
FROM batsman_scored b
FULL OUTER JOIN extra_runs e
  ON b.match_id = e.match_id
  AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
  AND b.over_id = e.over_id
GROUP BY
  coalesce(b.match_id, e.match_id),
  coalesce(b.innings_no, e.innings_no),
  coalesce(b.over_id, e.over_id)
views.description: Compute total runs conceded in each over (per match, innings, over_id) by summing batsman runs and extra runs. One row per match_id, innings_no, over_id with the runs total (raw measures) and a flag if there were any ball_by_ball rows for that over.

views.name: over_to_bowler
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.bowler AS bowler_id,
  CASE WHEN b.bowler IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_ball_records
FROM (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    innings_no,
    over_id,
    MIN(bowler) AS bowler
  FROM ball_by_ball
  GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
) b
views.description: Map each over (match_id, innings_no, over_id) to the bowler who bowled deliveries in that over based on ball_by_ball. Assumes all deliveries in same match/innings/over have same bowler. Also exposes a flag indicating whether a bowler was found.

views.name: player_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player.player_id,
  player.player_name,
  player.dob,
  player.country_name,
  player.batting_hand,
  player.bowling_skill
FROM player
views.description: Canonical player basic info (id, name, country, dob) for joining player metadata to computed measures.

views.name: delivery_level_ball_with_runs_and_extras
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.bowler,
  b.team_bowling,
  b.striker,
  COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS runs_off_bat,
  COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) AS extras_runs,
  (COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs_off_delivery
FROM ball_by_ball AS b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored AS bs
  ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
  AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
LEFT JOIN extra_runs AS er
  ON b.match_id = er.match_id
  AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
  AND b.over_id = er.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
views.description: One row per delivered ball (delivery) with canonicalized runs scored, extras, and the bowling player attached. Joins ball_by_ball to batsman_scored and extra_runs so each delivery shows runs_off_bat and extras attributed to that delivery (NULLs normalized to 0).

views.name: wicket_events_at_delivery
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  w.match_id,
  w.innings_no,
  w.over_id,
  w.ball_id,
  b.bowler AS bowler,
  w.player_out,
  w.kind_out
FROM wicket_taken w
JOIN delivery_level_ball_with_runs_and_extras b
  ON w.match_id = b.match_id
  AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND w.over_id = b.over_id
  AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
views.description: One row per delivery that had a wicket event (if any). Joins wicket_taken to ball_by_ball to attribute the wicket to the bowler of that delivery. Normalizes presence of a wicket (boolean) and exposes player_out and kind_out.

views.name: bowler_aggregate_by_player
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.bowler AS bowler_player_id,
  SUM(d.total_runs_off_delivery) AS bowler_total_runs_conceded,
  COUNT(w.ball_id) AS bowler_wickets_taken
FROM delivery_level_ball_with_runs_and_extras d
LEFT JOIN wicket_events_at_delivery w
  ON d.match_id = w.match_id
  AND d.innings_no = w.innings_no
  AND d.over_id = w.over_id
  AND d.ball_id = w.ball_id
  AND d.bowler = w.bowler
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id, bowler FROM delivery_level_ball_with_runs_and_extras) b
  ON d.match_id = b.match_id
  AND d.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND d.over_id = b.over_id
  AND d.ball_id = b.ball_id
  AND d.bowler = b.bowler
GROUP BY b.bowler
views.description: Aggregated measures per bowler (player) across all deliveries: total_runs_conceded (sum of total runs on deliveries they bowled) and total_wickets_taken (count of wicket events on their deliveries). Keeps one row per bowler (player_id). Does not filter out players with zero wickets; that filter belongs in question_ops.

views.name: ball_events_with_striker_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.striker,
  b.team_batting,
  bs.runs_scored,
  p.player_name
FROM ball_by_ball AS b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored AS bs
  ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
  AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
  AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
LEFT JOIN player AS p
  ON p.player_id = b.striker
views.description: One row per delivered legal ball event (ball_by_ball) joined to the runs scored on that ball (batsman_scored) and basic player info for the striker. Keeps raw runs per ball to allow match-level aggregation of striker runs.

views.name: striker_runs_per_match
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.striker AS player_id,
  SUM(b.runs_scored) AS total_runs_in_match
FROM
  ball_events_with_striker_runs b
GROUP BY
  b.striker,
  b.match_id
views.description: Aggregated totals of runs scored by each striker in each match (one row per striker per match). Exposes the per-match total run measure so questions can filter for thresholds (e.g., >50) and compute averages across players.

views.name: player_match_participation
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.match_id AS match_id,
  pm.player_id AS player_id,
  pm.team_id AS team_id,
  pm.role AS role
FROM player_match pm
views.description: One row per player appearance in a match recording which team the player represented and their role in that match (a cleaned subset of player_match).

views.name: ball_player_event
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.striker,
  b.non_striker,
  b.bowler,
  b.team_batting,
  b.team_bowling,
  bs.runs_scored,
  er.extra_runs,
  er.extra_type,
  wt.player_out,
  wt.kind_out
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
  AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
  AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
  ON er.match_id = b.match_id
  AND er.over_id = b.over_id
  AND er.ball_id = b.ball_id
  AND er.innings_no = b.innings_no
LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt
  ON wt.match_id = b.match_id
  AND wt.over_id = b.over_id
  AND wt.ball_id = b.ball_id
  AND wt.innings_no = b.innings_no
views.description: One row per ball delivery annotated with batting and bowling player ids and the ball-level runs; joins ball_by_ball with batsman_scored and extra_runs/wicket_taken via shared match/over/ball/innings to present a canonical per-ball event useful for attributing runs to players.

views.name: player_match_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.striker AS player_id,
  pb.team_id,
  SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_scored_in_match
FROM
  ball_by_ball b
JOIN
  batsman_scored bs
  ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
  AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
LEFT JOIN
  player_match pb
  ON b.match_id = pb.match_id
  AND b.striker = pb.player_id
GROUP BY
  b.match_id,
  b.striker,
  pb.team_id
views.description: Per player per match totals of runs scored aggregated from ball-level events (sums batsman_scored.runs_scored for balls where ball_by_ball.striker = player_id, grouped at the player-match level).

views.name: matches_in_season
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match.match_id,
  match.season_id,
  match.match_date,
  match.team_1,
  match.team_2,
  match.venue
FROM match
views.description: All matches restricted to a particular season (cohort of match rows).

views.name: player_match_appearances
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_match.player_id AS player_id,
  player_match.match_id AS match_id,
  player_match.team_id AS team_id,
  player_match.role AS role
FROM player_match
views.description: Player appearance rows linking players to matches and teams (one row per player in a match).

views.name: player_ball_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.runs_scored,
  bb.striker
FROM batsman_scored AS b
LEFT JOIN ball_by_ball AS bb
  ON b.match_id = bb.match_id
  AND b.over_id = bb.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = bb.ball_id
  AND b.innings_no = bb.innings_no
views.description: Ball-level runs credited to the batting player, joined to match to allow season filtering. Each row is a single ball event for which runs_scored is recorded.

views.name: player_ball_level_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.innings_no,
  bb.striker AS player_id,
  b.runs_scored
FROM
  batsman_scored b
JOIN
  ball_by_ball bb
  ON b.match_id = bb.match_id
  AND b.over_id = bb.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = bb.ball_id
  AND b.innings_no = bb.innings_no
views.description: Ball/ball-event level scoring rows joined to the player who scored (striker/player). Each row represents one scored entry (from batsman_scored linked to ball_by_ball) with match/over/ball/innings and the scoring player. Useful to compute total runs per player across matches.

views.name: player_profile_with_country
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player.player_id AS player_id,
  player.country_name AS country_name,
  player.player_name AS player_name,
  player.dob AS dob
FROM player
WHERE player.country_name IS NOT NULL
views.description: Canonical player rows with player_id and country_name (cleaned). Exposes players with non-NULL country for grouping by country.

views.name: over_level_runs_raw
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(b.match_id, e.match_id) AS match_id,
  COALESCE(b.innings_no, e.innings_no) AS innings_no,
  COALESCE(b.over_id, e.over_id) AS over_id,
  COALESCE(b.batsman_runs, 0) AS batsman_runs,
  COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0) AS extra_runs,
  (COALESCE(b.batsman_runs, 0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0)) AS over_total_runs
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      match_id,
      innings_no,
      over_id,
      SUM(runs_scored) AS batsman_runs
    FROM batsman_scored
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
  ) b
FULL OUTER JOIN
  (
    SELECT
      match_id,
      innings_no,
      over_id,
      SUM(extra_runs) AS extra_runs
    FROM extra_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
  ) e
ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no AND b.over_id = e.over_id
views.description: Per match/innings/over raw summed runs from batsman_scored and extra_runs (treat missing rows as zero). One row per match_id, innings_no, over_id with component sums and total_over_runs.

views.name: over_bowler_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.bowler,
  MIN(b.ball_id) AS ball_id
FROM
  ball_by_ball b
GROUP BY
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.bowler
views.description: Deterministic single bowler per match/innings/over. From ball_by_ball pick the row with smallest ball_id for each match_id, innings_no, over_id and expose bowler.

views.name: match_best_over_candidates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  o.match_id,
  o.innings_no,
  o.over_id,
  o.over_total_runs,
  b.ball_id AS bowler
FROM
  over_level_runs_raw o
JOIN (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    MIN(innings_no) AS innings_no,
    MIN(over_id) AS over_id,
    MAX(over_total_runs) AS over_total_runs
  FROM (
    SELECT
      match_id,
      innings_no,
      over_id,
      over_total_runs
    FROM over_level_runs_raw
  )
  GROUP BY match_id
) m
  ON o.match_id = m.match_id
  AND o.innings_no = m.innings_no
  AND o.over_id = m.over_id
LEFT JOIN over_bowler_lookup b
  ON o.match_id = b.match_id
  AND o.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND o.over_id = b.over_id
views.description: Per match, candidate best over rows: for each match_id, select the single over (across all innings) with the maximum over_total_runs. Tie-breaker deterministic: smallest innings_no then smallest over_id. Also include bowler by joining to over_bowler_lookup.

views.name: season_bowler_wicket_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.season_id AS season_id,
  wt.player_out AS bowler_player_id,
  COUNT(*) AS bowler_total_wickets
FROM wicket_taken wt
JOIN match m ON m.match_id = wt.match_id
WHERE m.season_id IS NOT NULL
  AND wt.kind_out NOT IN ('run out','hit wicket','retired hurt')
GROUP BY
  m.season_id,
  wt.player_out
views.description: Bowler wicket counts per season: counts wicket_taken rows (excluding specified dismissal kinds) for each bowler in matches of a season. One row per (season_id, bowler player_id).
